units.source_text: 小皇子三岁那一年，举行穿裙仪式[\[5\]](#part1330.html#m5)，排场不亚于大皇子当年。

en.t: In the year when the little prince turned three, the trouser-skirt ceremony was held for him, with a display no less splendid than the elder prince's had been.

units.source_text: 内藏寮[\[6\]](#part1330.html#m6)和纳殿[\[7\]](#part1330.html#m7)的物资尽行提取出来，仪式非常隆重。

en.t: Supplies from the Palace Storehouse Office and the imperial treasury were all brought out, and the ceremony was exceptionally grand.

units.source_text: 这也引起了世人种种非难。

en.t: This too drew all sorts of criticism from people in the world.

units.source_text: 及至见到这小皇子容貌漂亮，仪态优美，竟是个盖世无双的玉人儿，谁也不忍妒忌他。

en.t: But once they saw that the little prince was beautiful in face and graceful in bearing, truly a jewel-like child without equal in the world, no one had the heart to envy him.

units.source_text: 见多识广的人见了他都吃惊，对他瞠目注视，叹道：“这神仙似的人也会降临到尘世间来！”

en.t: Even people of wide experience were astonished when they saw him; they stared at him wide-eyed and sighed, "Can someone like an immortal really descend into this dusty world?"
